_note:
Acronis TRU May 1 2026: 575+ malicious skills across 13 dev accounts on HuggingFace skills marketplace. Primary actors: hightower6eu (334 skills), sakaen736jih (199 skills). Cross-platform Windows + macOS payloads (AMOS, cryptominers, infostealers). Novel TTP relative to ClawHavoc: indirect prompt injection embedded in SKILL.md metadata itself — when the agent fetches the skill description for review, metadata carries hidden instructions causing the agent to fetch + execute external code.

This fixture exercises instruction_shape_in_tool_result against the SKILL.md retrieval shape. clawhavoc_clickfix covered the user-facing ClickFix shape; this is the model-facing prompt-injection shape. 4 findings: 2× instruction_shape (imperative + ignore-previous) + spectral_anomaly + spectral_motif_match (exfil_pipeline_3path on the 4-event read→transform→write graph).

Sources: Acronis TRU May 1 2026; SecurityWeek May 1 2026; corpus extension §2.2.
